Python code reference

source files. Sphinx uses `autodoc` for this.

Database models

news.models

Database models for Cape News accounts, stories and newsletters.

  • User — User account with a role and reader subscriptions.
  • Publisher — News publisher that can have editors and journalists.
  • Article — Article written by a journalist and optionally linked to a publisher.
  • Newsletter — Collection of approved articles put together by staff.
  • ApprovalLog — Keep a record of an approved article received by our own API.

Website views

news.views

Pages for reading stories and managing the Cape News website.

  • article_list — Show the public list of approved articles.
  • article_detail — Show one approved article to a normal website visitor.
  • register — Create an account using the role selected on the registration page.
  • article_create — Let a Journalist submit an article for Editor approval.
  • my_articles — Give Journalists a simple place to manage their own work.
  • article_update — Allow an Editor or the article owner to edit an article.
  • article_delete — Allow Editors or the article owner to delete an article.
  • editor_review — Show Editors the articles that are still waiting for approval.
  • notify_approved_article — Email subscribers and POST the approval to our signed internal API.
  • approve_article — Approve an article, email subscribers and POST to /api/approved/.
  • newsletter_list — Show newsletters and the approved articles inside them.
  • newsletter_create — Allow Journalists and Editors to create newsletters.
  • newsletter_update — Allow an Editor or newsletter owner to update a newsletter.
  • newsletter_delete — Allow an Editor or newsletter owner to delete a newsletter.
  • subscriptions — Let Readers choose the publishers and journalists they follow.

API views

news.api_views

REST API endpoints for articles and editor approvals.

  • ArticleListCreateAPIView — GET approved articles and POST a new Journalist article.
  • ArticleDetailAPIView — GET one article and allow permitted updates/deletes.
  • SubscribedArticlesAPIView — Return approved articles from a Reader's subscriptions only.
  • ApprovedArticleAPIView — Receive and store signed approval messages from our own application.

Forms

news.forms

Website forms for signing up and writing stories.

  • UserRegistrationForm — Registration form for the three user roles used by the news website.
  • ArticleForm — Form used by journalists and editors when working with articles.
  • NewsletterForm — Form for creating and editing newsletters.
  • SubscriptionForm — Lets a Reader choose publishers and journalists to follow.

API serializers

news.serializers

Turn our news models into JSON and check API input.

  • UserSerializer — Small safe version of a user for API responses.
  • PublisherSerializer — Publisher information used by the API.
  • ArticleSerializer — Article serializer used for list, create and detail endpoints.
  • NewsletterSerializer — Newsletter serializer required by the project brief.

API permissions

news.permissions

Make sure each user role can only do what it is allowed to do.

  • ArticlePermission — Apply the Reader, Editor and Journalist rules to article API calls.

Role setup

news.signals

Set up the Reader, Editor and Journalist groups after migrations.

  • create_role_groups — Create role groups and give them the permissions from the brief.
